chart.empty: No data in the filtered period.
chart.noData: Not enough data in the filtered period.
chart.export.failDesc: the chart is not ready yet
chart.lines.title: Lines added × removed per month
chart.cycle.title: Cycle time trend — last 6 months
chart.cycle.few: Too few merged PRs in the last 6 months to measure a trend.
chart.cycle.footnote: median cycle time (creation → merge) per month, with (n PRs) · rising = 3 months in a row up · ignores the period filter and the scope (github.json has no axis)
chart.fix.title: Fix hotspots — % of fixes per repo
chart.fix.footnote: hot = ≥{red}% of commits are fix · attention = ≥{amber}% · repos with <{min} commits in the period are ignored
chart.bus.title: Bus factor — concentration per repository
chart.bus.blindSpot: the top dev also dominates reviews
chart.bus.footnote: high = 1 dev with ≥{red}% and ≤{maxDevs} active devs, or the top dev (≥{amber}%) who also does ≥{blindShare}% of reviews · medium = 1 dev with ≥{amber}% · repos with <{min} commits in the period are ignored
chart.off.title: Off hours
chart.off.empty: No weekend or late-night commits in the period.
chart.off.footnoteBase: weekend = Sat/Sun · overnight = 10pm–6am · pattern = ≥{pct}% off hours
chart.off.footnote8w: or {n}+ of the last 4 weekends active (fixed 8-week window — follows the scope, ignores the period)
chart.off.footnotePeriod: in the period · devs with <{min} commits in the period are ignored
chart.weekly.title: Weekly champion — biggest improvement
chart.weekly.empty: No week with {min}+ commits in the period — no champion.
chart.weekly.footnote: Win = biggest jump over the dev's own average of the previous {baseline} weeks (commits ÷ (average + 1), minimum {min} in the week) — rewards pace, not raw volume. The average uses the previous {baseline} calendar weeks inside the filtered period (an empty week counts 0; weeks before the start of the period don't count); weeks with no previous week in the period are left out of the ranking, and weeks without a candidate are skipped.
chart.prCycle.title: Median cycle time per repo (creation → merge, day cutoff)
chart.types.repoTitle: Mix per repo (% — sorted by fix)
chart.repoShare.title: Distribution per repository (filtered period)
chart.graph.title: Commit graph
chart.graph.noData: No commit graph for this repo — run
chart.graph.footnote: latest {n} {unit} · ~{days} days · merges are drawing connectors (metrics still exclude merges) · fixed window: does not follow the period/bots/scope filters
chart.graph.clippedOne: · {n} dashed edge with arrow: parent outside the window — the history continues older
chart.graph.clippedMany: · {n} dashed edges with arrows: parents outside the window — the history continues older
chart.typeMix.title: Commit types in the period
